data: Tout pour être heureux (Dad in Training)

Antoine, bientôt quarantenaire, dilettante, égoïste et insatisfait ne s’est jamais réellement senti investi d’une mission pour s’occuper de ses filles, âgées de 5 et 9 ans. Infantilisé par sa femme Alice, Antoine n’arrive pas à trouver sa place dans son foyer et décide subitement de la quitter pour une histoire sans lendemain. Lorsqu’Alice lui confie leurs filles quelques jours par surprise, Antoine va se retrouver sur un continent inconnu. Et alors qu’il était incapable d’assumer son rôle de père à l’intérieur du noyau familial, il va finir par devenir une véritable « mère juive ». Après avoir quitté sa femme par nostalgie de sa liberté d’antan, le nouvel Antoine va se retrouver confronté à une nouvelle nostalgie, celle de sa vie de famille… (Antoine, approaching forty, dilettante, egoist, and unsatisfied, has never really felt a true mission to take care of his daughters, aged 5 and 9. Treated like a child by his wife Alice, Antoine can't manage to find a place in his home and suddenly decides to leave for an affair with no tomorrow. When Alice leaves their daughters with him for a few days by surprise, Antoine finds himself on unknown territory. Incapable of assuming the father role within the family unit, he will end up by becoming a genuine "Jewish mother." After leaving his wife due to nostalgia for his former freedom, the new Antoine will find himself confronted by a new nostalgia - for family life.)

Antoine, approaching forty, dilettante, egoist, and unsatisfied, has never really felt a true mission to take care of his daughters, aged 5 and 9. Treated like a child by his wife Alice, Antoine can't manage to find a place in his home and suddenly decides to leave for an affair with no tomorrow. When Alice leaves their daughters with him for a few days by surprise, Antoine finds himself on unknown territory. Incapable of assuming the father role within the family unit, he will end up by becoming a genuine "Jewish mother." After leaving his wife due to nostalgia for his former freedom, the new Antoine will find himself confronted by a new nostalgia - for family life.
